+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.syntax import Syntax
+import sys
+
+def test_syntax_padding():
+    console = Console(width=40, force_terminal=True)
+    syntax = Syntax("print('hello world')", lexer="python", background_color="blue", padding=1)
+    console.print(syntax)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_syntax_padding()

     def __rich_console__(
         self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
     ) -> RenderResult:
+        if self.padding:
+            _, right, _, left = Padding.unpack(self.padding)
+            options = options.update(
+                width=options.width - left - right if options.width else None,
+                max_width=options.max_width - left - right if options.max_width else None,
+            )
+

         if self.padding:
